description: A small silver padlock with a key attached sits on the bed in front of the hands. The left hand moves in to steady the padlock as a left-hand object, while the right hand grasps the key as a right-hand object and inserts it into the lock; the right hand twists and pulls, and the shackle separates from the lock body so the lock opens, leaving the left hand holding the detached shackle and the right hand holding the lock body.
